name: V-PLUGIN-SQL-PROCEDURE
description: SQL Call procedure on PostgreSQL, MariaDB, Oracle and SQL Server: the seed procedure's out values as a one-row table, an in-out argument fed from that table and called in the Arguments order, and routines that return rows; the Called line of every finished call, a result cut by Max rows and a call with no Arguments recorded; every routine the run makes is dropped in the Finally path.

values.sql:
CREATE PROCEDURE wave_diff___TOKEN__(IN later INT, IN earlier INT, INOUT acc INT) SET acc = acc + later - earlier;
CREATE PROCEDURE wave_rows___TOKEN__(IN n INT) WITH RECURSIVE s(k) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT k + 1 FROM s WHERE k < n) SELECT k, k * k AS sq FROM s ORDER BY k;

data.label: PostgreSQL capped rows call
data.description: PostgreSQL rows call capped by Max rows

data.label: PostgreSQL no arguments call
data.description: PostgreSQL seed call with no Arguments recorded

values.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM pg_proc WHERE proname IN ('wave_diff___TOKEN__', 'wave_rows___TOKEN__', 'wave_fout___TOKEN__')

DROP PROCEDURE IF EXISTS wave_diff___TOKEN__;
DROP PROCEDURE IF EXISTS wave_rows___TOKEN__;
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM information_schema.routines WHERE routine_schema = DATABASE() AND routine_name IN ('wave_diff___TOKEN__', 'wave_rows___TOKEN__')

DROP PROCEDURE IF EXISTS wave_diff___TOKEN__;
DROP PROCEDURE IF EXISTS wave_rows___TOKEN__;
SELECT count(*) AS "n" FROM user_objects WHERE object_name IN (UPPER('wave_diff___TOKEN__'), UPPER('wave_rows___TOKEN__'))

DROP PROCEDURE IF EXISTS dbo.wave_diff___TOKEN__;
DROP PROCEDURE IF EXISTS dbo.wave_rows___TOKEN__;
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM sys.procedures WHERE name IN ('wave_diff___TOKEN__', 'wave_rows___TOKEN__')
